text:
alex_cs: Customer JD reporting 403s for both /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings since their SSO-created service key. Says calls used to work earlier today.

maya_oncall: can you paste the curl and the 403 body they saw? rough timeframe?

alex_cs: sent timestamps and sample curl from customer: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXXX\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"input\":\"hello\"}'
```
Response: 403 {\"error\":\"insufficient_scope\", \"message\":\"missing: inference, embeddings\"}

alex_cs: same key returns 403 on /v1/generate with missing inference in message. customer says token was provisioned via our Okta connector (SCIM).

sam_engineer: interesting — usually SCIM provisioning bugs are comma/space delimiter things or trailing whitespace. can you paste the decoded JWT payload (just scp claim)?

alex_cs: pasted decoded payload from customer (redacted): 
```
{
  \"sub\": \"svcacct:acme:frontend\",
  \"scp\": \"inference,\u00A0embeddings\",
  \"iat\": 1709501200,
  \"exp\": 1709587600
}
```
Note: between comma and embeddings that's U+00A0 (non-breaking space) not normal ASCII space. customer attached file showing admin CSV used to provision had NBSPs inserted by their identity team tooling.

maya_oncall: aha — our token-scope matcher splits on comma and trims ASCII spaces but doesn't normalize NBSP. runtime checks for exact scope strings, so \"embeddings\" != \"\u00A0embeddings\".

eli_infra: repro steps I ran: minted a token with scp value containing NBSP and called embed/gen — got 403 with same missing-scopes message. quick proof:
```
# simulate claim
scp='inference,\u00A0embeddings'
# our authlib receives scp header as-is and checks membership
```
Result: denied.

opsbot: Note: escalated to ENG (internal ticket ENG-priv-488) to add scope normalization in the auth parser (trim Unicode whitespace, normalize NBSP).

sam_engineer: short-term mitigation options for customer: 1) Re-provision the service key from console (our provisioning UI strips/normalizes whitespace). 2) Use the admin API to PATCH the token's scp claim to replace NBSP with ASCII comma+space. 3) As a workaround, we can create a new key with manual scopes.

alex_cs: customer JD tried re-provisioning via Console and confirmed new key works — calls succeed. they were anxious because this impacted nightly batch jobs.

maya_oncall: please log the exact repro and attach the customer's CSV sample to ENG ticket. also add note to runbook: \"If 403 for multiple endpoints after SSO provisioning, check for non-ASCII whitespace in scp claim.\" :warning:

eli_infra: I pushed quick validation to the provisioning path to reject non-ASCII whitespace in admin UI while ENG fixes parser. added unit test for NBSP.

sam_engineer: follow-up: ENG-priv-488 will introduce normalizing on decode and a CI test. target patch next week.

alex_cs: closing loop with customer: JD confirmed jobs back to normal, asked for RCA. I gave summary and ticket link. they were satisfied with workaround and wanted ETA on fix.

maya_oncall: marking resolved for now. thanks team :thumbsup:

customer_jd: thanks all for the fast turnaround, especially Maya and Alex. much appreciated.
